intro: Races coming up for our junior runners. Tap Add to my calendar to save one to your phone.
contact: Questions? Ask a coach at training, or message the parents' WhatsApp group. Always check the organiser's own page before you travel.

events.name: BeckBusters 2km Fun Run
events.venue: Bishop Monkton Primary School, St Johns Road, Bishop Monkton, HG3 3QW
events.notes: Enter in advance - there are no entries on the day, and places are limited. The fun run goes off before the 10km. Under 8s must be accompanied by an adult, who does not need to enter or pay. Chip timed, medal for every finisher. Start time not published yet - check the entry page.

events.name: English Schools Fell Running Championships
events.venue: Sedbergh School, Lupton Fields, Sedbergh, LA10 5AB
events.distance: 3.5km (Y7) / 4.9km (Y8 and Y9) / 6.3km (Y10 and Y11) / 7.3km (Y12 and Y13)
events.notes: Entries usually go through your school, so let them know if you want to run. First race 11:00 (Y7), then 11:30, 12:15 and 13:15. Prizes at 14:30. Fell or trail shoes, waterproof top, hat and gloves are compulsory - no kit, no run.

events.name: Wharfedale Harriers Quarry Runs
events.ageGroups: U10 to U18, minimum age 6 on the day. Ages are taken as at 31 December 2026
events.notes: Registration from 9:30 at the cricket hut, West End Cricket Club, Penistone Hill. First race 10:30 for U10s, the rest follow on. Goody bag for every runner, prizes for the top three in each age group and for fancy dress.

events.name: BOFRA - Wasdale Show
events.notes: U12 + U14: COMPULSORY. Waterproof jacket (taped seams).

events.name: Leeds Relays
events.distance: 1 mile (U10 and U12) / 2 miles (U14 and U16) / relay teams of four with 2 mile legs (U18 and U20)
events.notes: Hosted by the University of Leeds Cross Country Society, who have invited the club - tell a coach if you would like to run. Registration closes at 10:30, half an hour before the first race. Junior start times: 11:00 U10 boys, 11:05 U10 girls, 11:20 U12 boys, 11:25 U12 girls, 11:40 U14 boys, 11:45 U14 girls, 12:20 U16 boys, 12:25 U16 girls. Boys and girls start together but are timed separately. U18 and U20 run in the relays with the seniors at 13:00 (women) and 14:00 (men and mixed).

events.name: West Yorkshire XC League - Race 1
events.distance: 2500m (U12) / 3500m (U14) / 4000m (U16 girls) / 5000m (U16 boys and U18 women) / 6500m (U18 men)
events.ageGroups: U12, U14, U16 and U18, with separate races for boys and girls. Junior ages are taken as at 31 August 2027, so U12 runners must be born on or before 31 August 2017 - there is no U10 race
events.notes: Meeting 1 of 5. Enter in advance through the SportSoft system linked from the league page - there are no entries on the day. One £25 fee covers the whole league. Entries for this first meeting close on 4 October; if you miss that, entries reopen afterwards for the remaining four. Every runner needs an up to date England Athletics registration. You collect a league number at this meeting - keep it for the rest of the season. Races start no earlier than: 11:45 U12 girls, 11:55 U12 boys, 12:05 U14 girls, 12:20 U14 boys, 12:40 U16 girls, 12:55 U16 boys, 13:00 U18 women, 13:20 U18 men.

events.notes: Meeting 2 of 5, and a Saturday rather than a Sunday. You need to run at least four of the five meetings to qualify for a league award.
